assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ORIGINAL finished full-screen STARTING GAME / loading splash for Rainbow Patrol, matching its richly painted high-resolution Amiga adventure-game artwork. Landscape1536x1024, composed safely for8:5 crop, all important faces and aircraft inside64px edge margins. Original WWI grass airfield, canvas hangar and timber workshops at warm early-morning light, storm clouds gathering in distant blue mountains. MAIN SUBJECT: a coral-red and cream Sopwith-style biplane with two proper wings and struts, radial engine, black wheels, tailwheel firmly on the grass in a three-point parked stance, occupying center and upper-right, beautiful detailed fabric/metal/wood. It is actively being REFUELLED before an urgent sortie: one mechanic in rolled sleeves and braces works a brass hand pump on a battered wheeled fuel drum at center-left, a thick hose leads from that pump to a second mechanic standing beside the cockpit/fuselage filler on the wing root, carefully filling the plane. A leather-jacketed pilot with goggles and cream scarf hurries in from the right carrying gloves, another ground-crew figure at far-left hustles with a tool bag; use energetic credible poses, swinging scarf, rustling canvas and scattered preparation activity. The aircraft engine is OFF and its wooden propeller is stopped; urgency comes from the busy human crew, not unsafe running engine or explosions. Pump, drum, hose and fueling action must be clearly readable. Original welcoming characters, expressive faces, tactile aged brass, oil-stained timber, leather, warm coral/cream/olive/azure palette, cinematic yet charming hand-painted brushwork, no chunky pixel blocks, photorealistic photography, vector flat art or modern CGI. A second small aircraft and a windsock in the distant field may suggest the wingman, but do not overcrowd the main action. CRITICAL LIVE STATUS AREA: reserve lower-left x80..690,y800..970 as a calm very dark blue-green shadow on a low canvas-covered supply chest/workbench, unobstructed by faces, hands, hose, major plane parts or legs. This quiet lower-left area is for the game's real small loading heading, status and animated bar added later; integrate it naturally into the painting, not a floating UI window or extra chalkboard. Keep the main fueling/crew action above or to the right of that status zone. No writing, title, logo, menu text, numbers, buttons, progress bars, labels or painted interface anywhere. This is an immersive new original hectic ground-crew refueling splash, not a menu screenshot.
